why: Start, signed out. The screen is told by its chosen tab. Its four tabs with icons from Relaid's set as near DSB's as it has: a magnifier for Start (search), a ticket for Your trips (card), a list for Departures (DSB draws a clock), a person for Profile. Plan and buy, a section's head drawn as the app draws Check in now (which the app marks a heading), is a heading too. The title, large at the top of the page with no bar, stays in the page. Get started here, the app's outlined button across its card with its words in its middle, is drawn so (centre, across its line) in the page's accent outline, DSB's red, not filled, as the app draws it. The date the app shows for when to travel is the app's own words for now (a recapture with where its texts' words sit).
title: Start
